principles: Runtime artifacts are not material product files and must not stale evidence
One registry must feed every consumer instead of duplicating path strings
Repair guidance must be explicit and opt-in when it mutates git tracking
Existing user files such as .gitignore must be preserved
drivers: Avoid activity.jsonl dirty/stale loops in old projects
Keep DONE gate and materialHash semantics mechanically consistent
Protect real source/config/docs changes from being hidden as runtime noise

options.name: A: Add a dedicated runtime artifact registry and wire consumers to it
pros: Single source of truth for runtime artifact semantics
Can drive materialHash exclusion, gitignore merge, doctor scan, and tests
Keeps environment facts and process facts cleanly separated
cons: Requires touching multiple consumers and adding contract coverage

options.name: B: Patch evidence-freshness to special-case activity.jsonl only
pros: Directly fixes the reported stale loop for one file
cons: Leaves baseline risk, init, doctor, and future runtime paths inconsistent

options.name: C: Rely on prompt/docs telling users to git rm --cached activity logs
cons: Does not protect future projects or automated gates

chosen: A: Add a dedicated runtime artifact registry and wire consumers to it
rationale: Choose the dedicated registry because the bug is cross-cutting: freshness, init, doctor, and git dirty classification all need the same runtime artifact truth source.

preMortem.trigger: A broad .koala/* rule is treated as non-material
preMortem.consequence: Real story evidence or audit artifacts could be hidden from freshness checks
preMortem.mitigation: Use explicit entries and keep .koala/story as process metadata, not generic runtime

preMortem.trigger: Merge implementation rewrites the file instead of appending missing entries
preMortem.mitigation: Append only missing required entries under a Koala-managed comment block

preMortem.scenario: Doctor repair mutates git tracking unexpectedly
preMortem.trigger: doctor runs git rm --cached without explicit repair flag
preMortem.mitigation: Report by default; mutate only under doctor --repair

preMortem.scenario: Tests pass in fresh repos but fail in historical tracked-log repos
preMortem.trigger: Coverage only checks untracked ignore patterns
preMortem.consequence: Original bug returns for existing projects
preMortem.mitigation: Add a smoke case with tracked .koala/activity.jsonl and materialHash freshness

preMortem.trigger: A new consumer hardcodes activity paths instead of importing registry
preMortem.consequence: Different gates disagree about runtime files
preMortem.mitigation: Add contract tests that inspect consumers or verify exported registry behavior across freshness/init/doctor
